domain_restrictions: n is an integer and n > 1
x is a real number satisfying (n-1)/n <= x

semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every integer n greater than 1, and for every real number x with (n-1)/n <= x < 1, the value E(n, x) equals H_n minus 1.
quantifier_order: for all n in integers with n > 1
for all x in real numbers with (n-1)/n <= x and x < 1

variables.name: x
variables.role: input variable restricted to an interval depending on n

witness_dependencies: no existential witnesses appear; the equation asserts equality for all allowed x

statement_nl: Let n be an integer greater than 1. If x is a real number with (n-1)/n <= x < 1, then E(n, x) = H_n - 1.
